reviews.text: Kacey and her team are exceptional. My dog can be nervous around new people and I’ve had some bad experiences with sitters, but Kacey assured me of their hiring process and set up a trial with me with our new sitter Jana. I was nervous to leave my little girl with someone new for an 11 day holiday but upon my departure and Jana’s arrival to my flat I was quickly assured everything was great. I got constant updates, multiple times during the day complete with pictures and videos and little tidbits of their social life together! I was so relieved my dog was in the best of care. Upon my return my home was in pristine condition and although completely unnecessary, my darling sitter left me a homemade dessert as a welcome home!! If you’re looking for a great sitter I highly recommend Kacey and her team!
This was our first time using the service & we were matched with a wonderful sitter! She was super-communicative & sent us lots of updates on our cat. We will definitely be using the service again.

Had a fabulous experience with Paws Galore. Really organised booking, taking care to understand all that I needed. My cat sitter went above and beyond to care for my beloved cat, whilst I was away. Received a detailed update and photos after each visit which made sure I was not worried about being away from home. I highly recommend this fabulous company. I feel much easier about going away now I have someone I trust 100% to take care of my cat and my home.

My wife and I have used Paws Galore house/pet sitting on numerous occasions, and feel particularly lucky to have drawn Jana as our sitter.  I have an albatross on my shoulder when traveling, resulting in some kind of delay/rerouting on our return trips, and Jana has always shown flexibility, covering things until our return.  And she takes wonderful care of our cats.  From the front office to the sitter(s), the service has always been stellar.

I'm so thankful to have found Paws Galore when I moved to London with my dog, Ember. We were lucky to be matched with Sonja for walks and house sits, and she's absolutely fantastic. Ember adores her and I know she's in good hands with Sonja. I highly recommend Paws Galore.

We’ve been using PG for about a year now, for our elderly cat, Furry Bob.  As an older cat, he has special care requirements and PG has been amazing in understanding them and looking after him while we are away. Kacey in the office is lovely to deal with and our regular sitter, Tanja, is amazing. 5 stars.  Clare and Kathryn.

Happy customer of Paws Galore’s cat sitting services here!  Ricardo has been sitting for my cat since he was a kitten, and it’s such a relief to know I’m leaving him with someone he knows and likes and someone I know I can trust!  Also, he’s the best cat photographer!  Scheduling is easy and convenient too.

We contacted Paws Galore via our hotel in London due to last minute change with our anniversary plans. We always take our dog on our anniversary trips and then got bought tickets to a show, I was so apprehensive as she ha my baby and we’ve never left her with someone. However the lovely Jana spent the evening with our girl Misha and she had the most lovely time just slept and was super comfortable with Jana. I felt at ease when we left the hotel to go to our event after meeting Jana and seeing how happy Misha was to be left with her. Would recommend anytime thank you 💖

I’ve used Paws Galore for years now and they always take great care of my cats for me when I’m away. They have a lovely team of friendly sitters, all fully vetted, who always take the time to get to know me and the moggies; I know my cats are in safe and caring hands and we come back to Paws Galore every time. Thanks guys!

We've had some fabulous experiences of pet/housesitting with Paws Galore over the past few years, all seamlessly organised from start to finish. It was the best decision to sign up with them.  If you're a potential petsitter or pet owner we thoroughly recommend you do the same.

We’ve had a fantastic experience with Paws Galore Pet Sitters and would highly recommend them. From the very beginning, communication has always been excellent, and it’s clear that they genuinely care about the pets they look after.

A very special thank you to Sonja, who has helped us multiple times with our Maine Coon cat, Hunter, and has been wonderful every single time. She is the only sitter we book because we trust her completely. Sonja is kind, reliable, professional, and clearly has a natural way with animals.

It gives us total peace of mind knowing Hunter is in such caring and capable hands. We always come home to a happy, relaxed, and well-cared-for cat, which says everything about the love and attention she gives him.

It’s not always easy to leave your pet with someone else, but Sonja and Paws Galore make the whole experience completely stress-free and reassuring. We’re so grateful for the care Hunter has received over the years, and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

Thank you again to Sonja and the whole team!

Paws Galore managed to find a pet sitter for our dog Rucola in less than 24 hours. That gave my family the opportunity to enjoy the British Museum during a short vacation in gorgeous London. The administration did a truly amazing job, working outside of office hours and answering our emails when it would have been entirely understandable if it didn't.  The pet-sitter himself, was punctual, reliable, friendly and extremely gentle. He bonded with our Rucola in no time and when we came back 4 hours later, we found a relaxed and happy puppy waiting for us. The price was reasonable and the payment options flexible. I strongly recommend Paws Galore to anyone who needs someone to take good care of our best friends while in London.

I recently moved to London and struggled to find someone I trusted with my pet and home. The service provided by Becky and the team was incredible. She took care of my pet like it was her own and my left my flat immaculate. I’m so happy I found Becky and Paws galore. Becky  made my trip stress-free.

Found Paws Galore online and sent an inquiry for a 6 day dog sit. Everybody I interacted with over email was incredibly professional and a joy to work with including Kacey and Lizzie. They offered up Ayse as the sitter with an introductory meeting, after which I decided to book it! Ayse did a great job, she kept up my dog’s routine very well and sent a number of updates including many pictures. My dog seemed to have a great time and was definitely very comfortable around Ayse by the time I got back. Will be booking again, thank you Ayse and team!

We’ve been using Paws Galore for the past 13 years and are so happy with the kind and reliable service we’ve received over that time.  In particular Brenda and Soraya are truly amazing cat sitters, going the extra mile with their dedication and love towards our cats. They send thoughtful daily updates, play with the cats and also keep our plants all nicely watered and alive while we’re away.
Thank you Fabiola

I have used PG for 2 years and I have had only positive experiences with them. The pet sitters are professional and caring, the reservation and payment processes are seamless and efficient, and everyone I have interacted with has always been nice and accommodating. I absolutely love the text updates I get from my pet sitter, he really cares about my two cats’ well-being and he is a real cat lover. I know they’re in good hands when I’m away.

UPDATE: after 7 years, I am still extremely happy. I thoroughly recommend PG to any London cat owner.

Found Paws Galore online and sent an enquiry. From the first email response Kacey and the team have been fantastic. Very helpful, responsive and accommodating. We had Jenny as our cat sitter for our two elderly (16&17 yo) cats. Jenny took time to understand their routines and needs. One of our cats has hypothyroid and Jenny was great at making sure our cat took her tablets and ensuring they had play time and strokes both morning and evening. I felt relaxed while we were away and I would recommend this company. Jenny also sent regular pics and updates and our cats seemed super happy in her care. Thank you team! We will be back for more! 🐈‍⬛ 🐈 thank you from James and Etty too 🐾

I recommend!  Lila came to care for my cat 2x a day for a few days while I was on a work trip, she sent me updates and pictures. When I came back my cat seemed happy (whereas previously she would be grumpy if I left her alone overnight..)

Fantastic ! Absolutely recommended. I had Mark as cat sitter took care of my Luna...perfectly! Great communication and fair prices !

I am now a regular and will be booking paws Galore again soon !

Thank you for taking away all my stress and anxiety whilst I was away!

Laura

I’m hugely grateful to Kacey and Brenda who looked after our cat over the summer for 2 weeks. This was the first time we’d used a cat sitter; we thought it was a better option for him to stay at home than to go to a cattery.
Kacey’s service and prompt and organised; She found a sitter quickly and the booking process is very easy to follow.

Brenda is a conscientious cat sitter, who did an amazing job looking after our cat, particularly as it was a lot of work getting him to eat for the first few days. She was very solutions oriented.  Brenda kept us updated with texts and images so we knew he was safe, which meant we could get on and enjoy the holiday.  By the end Brenda was his best friend and we came home to healthy and very loved little cat. Thank you Brenda!

We had a very good experience with Paws Galore. Brenda, our cat sitter, looked well after Artù. She took good care of him and sent many updates to us. We really appreciated when she managed to go last minute even if it was not planned in advance! Super happy with the service :)

Excellent service! Kacey is very accommodating and managed to even get me a last minute sitter. The sitters are great and friendly. I’ve had Aidan, Michelle and Becky. They were all lovely and took care of my puppy. I highly recommend Paws Galore pet sitters!

Thank you much for making our trip to London stress free. Frank was so friendly, polite and trustworthy. Frank, was a natural dog- lover. In the same sense,Brenda was equally as amazing, warm kind and assuring. Major enjoyed and so did we. …

I've used Pets Galore now a couple of times and have had a great experience both times.  My cats are fairly timid around new people and so I was apprehensive about leaving them in a total strangers' hands, but Kacey couldn't have been more …

Excellent professional service. Kasey matched us with a great couple to look after our 2 dogs while we were away for 8 nights. perfect sitters who looked after our dogs and house perfectly. Easy communication, fair prices, nothing a hassle - provided real peace of mind while we were away.

We needed a dog sitter/walker for our dog whilst staying at a hotel for our sons graduation. He is not always the easiest dog to handle being a rescue with a difficult past. Paws Galore sent an excellent young man who connected immediately with Connor (our dog) and did a great job of looking after him whilst we were at the ceremony.

I needed a cat sitter pretty last minute because my usual company dropped the ball. I called Paws Galore thinking it would be the first of several calls to find an available pet sitter. I spoke to Kacey and she was very nice and …
Users Paws Galore for a 11 day holiday.  Very happy with the sitter provided.  Communications and organisation was very good.
